spans.s: (= √ 1. शम्) cl. 4. P. शि॑म्यति, to cut up, prepare (a sacrificial victim), TS.; Kāṭh.
1. सिम् ind. g. चादि.
2. सिम् (in Vedic gram.) a technical term for the eight simple vowels (viz. अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ).

(originally acc. of a pron. base and connected with स as कीम् with क) him, her, it, them (employed for all genders, numbers and persons [cf. इद्; ईम्, and Gk. μιν, νιν]; and often weakened into a generalizing and emphasizing particle, which may become an enclitic particle after a pronoun or preposition, = περ or cunque, often translatable by ‘ever’), RV.
a cutter up or preparer (of sacrificial food), TS.
See दुः- and सु-शी॑म.
